verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms core invoicing and online-payment features (docs-17, docs-20, docs-9 'Generate invoices, track payments') and Zia AI collection reminders/tracking, but there is no explicit documentation of invoice 'viewed' status tracking or read-receipt style notifications. missing for 10: explicit documentation of invoice view/open tracking, payment gateway list, and hands-on/independent confirmation that founders can see real-time viewed/paid status.
